_doc: The town at the landing site (src/world/town.ts). All sizes in tiles unless named px; positions relative to the base center tile. square = the paved square around the vessel, the Replicator pad and the cradle (x, y = its top-left corner). street: width of every street, verge = the strip between a street and its lots (lamp posts stand there), row = the main (east/west) street's first row, col = the cross (north/south) street's first column. streets = how far each street runs out from the square's edge (shortened on small worlds so the town stays on the island; islandSafety = how much of the island radius is kept free of the ragged coast). lot = a home lot (along the street x deep), gap = tiles between neighbouring lots (trees may grow there). civic = a lot for a building (up to buildings.json maxFootprint); civicAt = where they go, in the order buildings take them (nw / ne flank the cross street at the square's north edge, w / e / n / s sit at the street ends). crossLots = home lots along the cross streets (n / s). margin = the open ground kept around the whole town (no rock, ruins, ponds, creatures or crystals; trees may stand there). hatch = the tile in the square's corner where the way down to the warren is dug. posts = street lamp spots on the verges (every postEvery tiles) and at the square's corners. slots = a home lot's build spots, at [along, depth] (along 0 = the left end seen from the street, depth 0 = the row by the street), with the kinds each takes in order of preference; lamps = the two lamp posts at a lot's frontage. Village builds fill their builder's lot; a lamp takes a frontage post, then the nearest free street post within lampReachPx. homeWander = how far a copy strolls from its yard [min, max] px, streetStroll = chance it walks its street toward the square instead. woodRadiusPx / woodHomeRadiusPx = trees a copy may cut for wood (from the base / from its own home). layout = the saved layout version (planet_states.data.layout) this town belongs to. paint = how the square, streets and footpaths are painted per floor style: square 'flags' (fitted stone) or 'earth' (packed earth), streetWear 0..1 (how bare a lived-in street is), trackWear (the faint track past the last home), edgePx (soft noisy street edge), path = the packed-earth color ramp (dark to light) of trodden streets and footpaths; a style's missing keys come from default. edgeFade: px from the square's edge in which flags go missing and moss fills the joints, so its outline is whole stones in the grass.
